tenderSchedule.title: H N PURA TALUK
tenderSchedule.description:
IINVITING A TENDER FOR PROVIDING A VEHICLE(LGV/MINIMUM 1.5 MT 
 CAPACITY) FOR TRANSPORTING AND DISTRIBUTING WHOLE MILK POWDER 
 AND RAGI HEALTH MIX POWDER OF KSHEERA BHAGYA SCHEME FROM 
 CHANNARAYAPATTANA MILK CHILLING CENTER GODOWN TO GOVERNMENT 
 AND AIDED SCHOOLS OF HOLENARASIPURA TALUK.
 THE BIDDER SHOULD QUOTE RATE PER KILOGRAM(KG) BASIS ONLY(THE 
 QUOTE RATE INCLUDES TRANSPORTING OF MILK POWDER AND RAGI HEALTH 
 MIX POWDER FROM CHANNARAYAPATTANA MILK CHILLING CENTER 
 GODOWN TO SCHOOLS, LOADING AND UNLOADING OF MILK POWDER AND 
 RAGI HEALTH MIX POWDER AND TOLL FEE).
 APPROX 5600 KG PER MONTH AND NUMBERS OF SCHOOLS TO BE SUPPLIED 
 APPROX-292.
tenderSchedule.deptName: Karnataka Co-operative Milk Producers Federation Limited
tenderSchedule.locationName: Managing Director Hassan Co-operative Milk Producers Union Union Pvt (PI)

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
THE BIDDER SHOULD FOLLOW ALL TERMS AND CONDITIONS OF TENDER DOCUMENT
